lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:
Raag Bihaagraa, Chau-Padhay, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
To associate with your arch enemies,
is to live with poisonous snakes;
I have made the effort to shake them off. ||1||
Then, I repeated the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,
and I obtained celestial peace. ||1||Pause||
False is the love
Of the many emotional attachments,
which suck the mortal into the whirlpool of reincarnation. ||2||
All are travellers,
who have gathered under the world-tree,
and are bound by their many bonds. ||3||
Eternal is the Company of the Holy,
where the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises are sung.
Nanak seeks this Sanctuary. ||4||1||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Bihaagraa, Ninth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har kee gat nahi kooo jaanai ||
lines.translation: No one knows the state of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਤਪੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ਅਰੁ ਬਹੁ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jogee jatee tapee pach haare ar bahu log siaane ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Yogis, the celibates, the penitents, and all sorts of clever people have failed. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ ਕਰਈ ਰਾਉ ਰੰਕ ਕਰਿ ਡਾਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chhin mahi raau ra(n)k kau karaee raau ra(n)k kar daare ||
lines.translation: In an instant, He changes the beggar into a king, and the king into a beggar.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੀਤੇ ਭਰੇ ਭਰੇ ਸਖਨਾਵੈ ਯਹ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਵਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: reete bhare bhare sakhanaavai yah taa ko bivahaare ||1||
lines.translation: He fills what is empty, and empties what is full - such are His ways. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਪਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪਿ ਪਸਾਰੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਦੇਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: apanee maaiaa aap pasaaree aapahi dekhanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: He Himself spread out the expanse of His Maya, and He Himself beholds it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਧਰੇ ਬਹੁ ਰੰਗੀ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa roop dhare bahu ra(n)gee sabh te rahai niaaraa ||2||
lines.translation: He assumes so many forms, and plays so many games, and yet, He remains detached from it all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਨਤ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਜਿਹ ਸਭ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: aganat apaar alakh nira(n)jan jih sabh jag bharamaaio ||
lines.translation: Incalculable, infinite, incomprehensible and immaculate is He, who has misled the entire world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਭਰਮ ਤਜਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਰਨਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਓ ॥੩॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sagal bharam taj naanak praanee charan taahi chit laaio ||3||1||2||
lines.translation: Cast off all your doubts; prays Nanak, O mortal, focus your consciousness on His Feet. ||3||1||2||
Raag Bihaagraa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਜਿੰਦੁੜੀਏ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam dhiaaeeai meree ji(n)duReee guramukh naam amole raam ||
lines.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O my soul; as Gurmukh, meditate on the invaluable Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਬੀਧਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਝਕੋਲੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ras beedhaa har man piaaraa man har ras naam jhakole raam ||
lines.translation: My mind is pierced through by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name. The Lord is dear to my mind. With the sublime essence of the Lord's Name, my mind is washed clean.
